scope: Final itinerary editing, booking handoff/checklist and report review
reviewExtent: Complete base-to-current diffs of four trip components, current remaining rendered bodies and report form; complete listed helper and route bodies. Parent identity/revision keys traced separately. Unchanged checkout route read as context.
invariants: Durable retry identities persist across unconfirmed plan/checklist writes; matching applied/replayed receipts required before confirmation
Owned plan revisions and generation/item preconditions enforced by routes and atomic RPC contracts
Checkout uses canonical provider product URL and matching handoff receipt; UI separates handoff and self-reported status from confirmed reservations
Feedback requires authenticated trip owner and finished itinerary; shared content report requires valid active share token
Submission locks, bounded requests and unmount guards retain input after failure; report success requires explicit success true
Modal keyboard trap, Escape and launcher focus restoration reviewed; mutation controls expose explicit review/recovery states

validation.command: bun run test -- nine targeted itinerary/booking/feedback/content-report suites

limits: Hosted authorization and real provider verification remain external
This group does not approve the entire candidate diff
